What's your favorite faction to play across any Total War game and why?

For me it would have to be Poland-Lithuania in Empire. I've had such fun with them, fighting off the German states along with Ottomans while trying to ensure that Russia doesn't get hungry. In my most memorable campaign, the Polish fleet helped establish a colony in the Americas. I had a general with the second name Kazinski (Butchered spelling) who I grew so attached to he ended up with own backstory and narrative. While he never managed to lose a battle, he was sent home in disgrace after losing 3/4 of his force to Sweden. From then he remained as a garrison force until his eventual death.

Owning Oslo to Cairo felt so wrong and I think I stopped playing due to the stupid amount of money I was earning where nothing felt like a challenge anymore. Up to that point however had been the most fun I've ever had in a Total war game.

TL;DR Polan Stronk So what about you guys?

Well, I've only played Rome 2 so far... (I just recently bought empire and shogun 2). Anyway, my favorite faction so far has to be Sparta..of course. It's just too damn entertaining doing a RP playthrough of them and their awesome units in the grand campaign and the WoS campaign.

But my very best campaign was when I started as Pathia, they started with a huge number of regions and client states. I got up to 54k gold a turn before I just quit because it was getting old steam rolling the map haha
Parthia was my first and favorite faction for Rome 2. Man, I feel like starting up a new campaign as them.
Most nostalgic campaign ever was my first Greek City states campaign on Rome 1. I really love the Selucide Empire though, they are my boys. Both in Rome 1 and 2
I loved the Greeks! Never really tried Selucids in 1. Selucids in 2 seem difficult AF!

Kazinski (Butchered spelling) who I grew so attached to he ended up with own backstory and narrative.

In shogun 1 I had a unit of naginata samurai that got destroyed in a battle. All of them died except 1 samurai. Well there was a bug (at least I think it was a bug) where units kept all their experience despite unit size, effectively making this one naginata samurai a hero. I would send him in the flanks of engaged enemy units and he would decimate them, only getting stronger and stronger with each battle. Before long he was routing entire ashigaru units by himself. I also grew very attached to this Hero. So much so that in later battles i would keep him by my general as a body guard. On a battle, where I was out numbered, the center or my line started to collapse I sent him in with my last reserve of ashigaru spears. It was almost a hopeless battle but I knew he along with my final reserves could turn the tide of the battle... He was killed by archers before he reached the front line almost immediately all my troops started to route. I was genuinely sad.

In R2 and Attilla I find myself gravitating towards the Roman factions since I've played so many hours as Romans in R1, and am more familiar with their army styles.

In Empire and Napoleon I always went with England due to the solid starting location.

Shogun 2 I always went with Imperial factions.
